<Picture 1> as the character reference, <Audio 1> as the reference audio driving the performance.

SHOT 1: 0-5 seconds. <Picture 1> is performing with deep emotion, lips moving naturally in perfect sync with the rhythm and tone of <Audio 1>. The camera slowly pushes in from a medium shot to a close-up, capturing the subtle micro-expressions and the atmospheric lighting reflecting in the eyes.

SHOT 2: 5-10 seconds. The camera performs a smooth, subtle orbit around the character. The performance intensifies, matching the climax of <Audio 1>. The character's body sways gently, and facial expressions convey the exact mood of the audio, with dynamic lighting shifts enhancing the dramatic effect.

SHOT 3: 10-15 seconds. The camera slowly pulls back to a medium-wide shot. As <Audio 1> reaches its conclusion, the character's movements gradually slow down, ending with a lingering, captivating gaze directly into the lens. The atmosphere remains immersive and cinematic.

Style: Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, highly detailed textures, smooth motion, perfect lip-sync and audio-visual alignment.
